cited.quote: The District Collector is to give a formal approval to the FIG formed by the Block Collective Farming Team
Two lakh farmers are to be federated into 10,000 FIGs and 2,000 FPGs

rationale: C2 is the GO of 2017-06-29 laying down the procedure for forming Farmers Interest Groups and 2,000 Farmer Producer Groups (guidelines for forming many associations). C4 confirms the scheme continuing with 2,000 new FPGs. Matches the indicator.

cited.quote: the Block Collective Farming Team should register the FIGs formed as per the Societies Act

rationale: C2, GO Ms.No.164 dated 2017-06-29, orders formation and registration of FIGs and FPGs under the Societies Act, which initiates registration of new farmer groups.

cited.quote: Government have accorded permission for operating the sand quarry in all river beds of Tamil Nadu

rationale: C1 and C2 describe government sand quarry operation and imported-sand sales, and C3/C4 concern anti-smuggling instructions. None shows a step to end the cases or for government extraction and sale of mineral sand as promised; these are related or neighbouring activities.

cited.quote: the Government for the benefit of farmers have decided to procure copra at the Minimum Support Price (MSP)
there is need for implementation of Price Support Scheme (PSS) to help the coconut growers

rationale: C3 is GO (Ms) No.56 of 2016-06-10 ordering copra procurement at MSP because the open-market price was lower. C1 shows the scheme being implemented again in 2021 for a price fall. Matches the promise.

cited.quote: the Government have further enhanced the Ulema Pension from Rs.1000/- to Rs.1500/-Per month

rationale: C1 recounts that the fifth-read GO (G.O.(Ms) No.57, dated in 2016, OCR garbled) enhanced the Ulema pension from Rs.1000 to Rs.1500 per month; the day and month are illegible so only the year is given. The later GO raises it to Rs.3000.

cited.quote: Washing Machines are provided to Adi Dravidar Welfare girls

rationale: C1 and C2 (policy notes) say washing machines are provided only to Adi Dravidar Welfare girls hostels, not tribal hostels. No GO, scheme launch or dated step is in the extracts, so there is no official operationalisation after the government took office.

cited.quote: hereby accord administrative approval for implementation of the project
Government of Tamil Nadu has proposed to offer Cloud Based Services such as Webhosting

rationale: C3 is a GO for enhancing the State Data Centre cloud and C2 is a cloud web-hosting service for students and entrepreneurs. Neither is an order connecting universities through cloud computing. Related cloud activity only.

cited.quote: It will initiate steps to implement cloud computing and e-Governance in the campus

rationale: C3 only states one university will initiate steps toward cloud computing (intent). C1, C2 and C4 concern the State Data Centre cloud and a student/entrepreneur web-hosting service, not a platform launched across universities.

cited.quote: Construction of 20,000 Check Dams at a total cost of Rs.250.36 Crore under MGNREGS
construction of farm ponds, renovation of supply channels and desilting of existing ponds, ooranies and MI tanks

rationale: C4 is GO (Ms) No.6 of 2018-01-05 permitting 20,000 check dams and approving guidelines. Desilting is only mentioned in an undated policy note (C2), with no dated order, so only the check-dam part is clearly ordered.

cited.quote: Construction of 20,000 Check Dams at a total cost of Rs.250.36 Crore under MGNREGS
Administrative sanction has been accorded for an estimated amount of Rs.5.43 crore for Cholavaram Tank

rationale: C3 is the 2018-01-05 GO sanctioning Rs.250.36 crore for check dams. C1 reports administrative sanctions with amounts for desilting four Chennai reservoirs and Rs.692.55 crore of check-dam works. Funds allocated for both parts, though the desilting is limited to reservoirs and undated.

cited.quote: will urge the Government of India to provide dual citizenship to Srilankan Tamil refugees in Tamil Nadu

rationale: C3 (Governor address, 2020-01-06) only says the government will urge the Centre. No Assembly resolution, letter or GO is shown. C1, C2 and C4 are welfare schemes for camp residents, not advocacy for dual citizenship.

cited.quote: switch over to revenue sharing based price fixation model for sugarcane
Government of Tamil Nadu has enacted Tamil Nadu Sugarcane (Regulation of Purchase Price) Act 2018

rationale: C4 (GO Ms.230, 2018-09-17) implements revenue-sharing pricing with a transitional incentive paid to cane farmers; C2 reports the 2018 Act. The farmers' share is addressed. Sugar mill profitability is not shown; C5 notes mills face a liquidity crunch.

cited.quote: accord administrative sanction for the construction of 46 Godowns in Regulated Markets in their own lands
So far, 111 Numbers of cold storage facilities with the capacity to handle 13,565 MTs have been created

rationale: C5 is GO Ms.No.32 of 2018-02-08 sanctioning 46 godowns in Regulated Markets for farmers. C3 reports cold storage facilities created. Both warehouses and cold storage are covered, though the earliest dated order shown is for godowns.

cited.quote: Government have sanctioned a sum of Rs.18.75 crore to establish Broiler units at 12 Districts

rationale: C1 to C3 show the 25% subsidy scheme launched in 2012-13, before this government, continuing with money sanctioned in a policy note. No GO or new scheme launch in the term is shown for broiler and native chicken farms. C4 and C5 cover backyard Aseel birds, a different scheme.

cited.quote: implementing the skill training program to train 50,000 candidates belonging to marginalised communities
accord permission to provide training to 15,000 urban youth to the tune of Rs.49.50 Crore
Government will establish skill training facilities in 60 blocks through Government Industrial Training Institutes

rationale: C5 (GO 162, 2019-09-09) and C4 (GO 23, 2021) order skill training for youth. C3 only says skill training facilities in 60 blocks will be established (plan). Training is implemented, but the training centres in panchayat unions are not shown as set up.

cited.quote: Steam Boilers for cooking food hygienically are provided to Adi Dravidar Welfare Hostels and GTR Schools

rationale: C1 and C2 (policy notes) state steam boilers are provided to ADW hostels and GTR schools, but give no dated GO or launch, and C2 suggests provision existed by 2017. No dated official step after the government took office is shown. Tribal welfare hostels are not clearly covered.

No extract concerns including the fishermen community in the Scheduled Tribes list or any urging of the Union on it. C1 is about Palk Bay and Jallikattu, C2 and C3 about existing Scheduled Tribes, C4 and C5 about a fishermen relief scheme.

The promise names no object (Build these in greater numbers), so it cannot be matched to any extract. The extracts cover an industrial policy, cold storage, check dams and a house building advance, none identifiably what was promised.

No extract concerns a corpus fund for merchant welfare. The corpus funds mentioned are for health insurance (C1, C4), accident claims (C2), HIV-affected children (C3) and collective farming groups (C5).

cited.quote: action is being taken by TNHB, for formation of self contained Satellite Townships

rationale: C1 reports TNHB satellite town works at Thirumazhisai near Chennai (first-phase works completed, plots and housing still to come), Thoppur-Uchapatti and Mullur. No dated GO is shown and the townships are not yet operational. C4 is only a policy statement of intent.
